title: Chronic environmental level exposure to perfluorooctane sulfonate overshadows graphene oxide to induce apoptosis through activation of the ROS-p53-caspase pathway in marine medaka Oryzias melastigma.
authors: Xu, Nan; Jiang, Xilin; Liu, Yan; Junaid, Muhammad; Ahmad, Manzoor; Bi, Chunqing; Guo, Wenjing; Jiang, Chen'ao; Liu, Shulin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PFOS和氧化石墨烯对海洋青鳉的凋亡毒性机制，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The widespread occurrence of perfluorooctane sulfonate (PFOS) and the mass production and application of graphene oxide (GO) lead to their inevitable release and interaction in the environment, which may enhance associated toxic impacts on aquatic organisms. This study elucidates the induction of apoptosis by 60-day chronic single and mixture exposures to environmentally relevant levels of PFOS (0.5 mug/L and 5 mug/L) and GO (1 mg/L) in adult marine medaka Oryzias melastigma. Results showed a significant increase (p < 0.05) in reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels, the apoptotic positive rate in livers, and activities of caspases 3, 8, and 9 in all treated groups compared to the control. PFOS individual and PFOS-GO combined exposures significantly impacted fish growth, upregulated expressions of six apoptosis-related genes including p53, apaf1, il1b, tnfa, bcl2l1, bax, as well as enriched cell cycle and p53 signaling pathways (transcriptomic analysis) related to apoptosis compared to control group. Besides higher ROS production, GO also had a higher binding affinity to proteins than PFOS, especially to caspase 8 as revealed by molecular docking. Overall, PFOS induced ROS-p53-caspase apoptosis pathway through multi-gene regulation during single or mixture exposure, while GO single exposure induced apoptosis through tissue damage and ROS-caspase pathway activation and direct docking with caspase 8 to activate the caspase cascade. Under co-exposure, the PFOS-induced apoptotic pathway overshadowed the GO-induced pathway, due to competition for limited active sites on caspases. These findings will contribute to a better understanding of the apoptosis mechanism and ecological risks of nanomaterials and per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances in marine ecosystems.
abstract_zh: 全氟辛烷磺酸（PFOS）的广泛存在以及氧化石墨烯（GO）的大量生产和应用，导致它们在环境中不可避免地释放和相互作用，这可能增强对水生生物的相关毒性影响。本研究阐明了在环境相关浓度下，PFOS（0.5 μg/L 和 5 μg/L）和 GO（1 mg/L）单独及混合暴露60天对成年海洋青鳉（Oryzias melastigma）诱导细胞凋亡的作用。结果显示，与对照组相比，所有处理组中活性氧（ROS）水平、肝脏凋亡阳性率以及caspase 3、8和9的活性均显著增加（p < 0.05）。PFOS单独暴露和PFOS-GO联合暴露显著影响鱼类生长，上调了包括p53、apaf1、il1b、tnfa、bcl2l1、bax在内的六个凋亡相关基因的表达，并富集了与凋亡相关的细胞周期和p53信号通路（转录组分析），与对照组相比差异显著。除产生更高的ROS外，GO对蛋白质的结合亲和力也高于PFOS，尤其是对caspase 8，这一点通过分子对接揭示。总体而言，PFOS在单独或混合暴露期间通过多基因调控诱导ROS-p53-caspase凋亡通路，而GO单独暴露则通过组织损伤和ROS-caspase通路激活以及直接与caspase 8对接来激活caspase级联反应诱导凋亡。在联合暴露下，由于对caspase上有限活性位点的竞争，PFOS诱导的凋亡通路掩盖了GO诱导的通路。这些发现将有助于更好地理解纳米材料和全氟及多氟烷基物质在海洋生态系统中的凋亡机制和生态风险。
